# Coverage of what the wire carries

**Generated by `NetworkedPropertyCoverageTests`. Do not edit.** Extracted from
`source-sdk-2013`'s client RecvTables and diffed against the strings this project's
shipped assemblies contain, so it cannot drift from the engine without the engine
changing.

**A name here is something the DEMO can tell us, not something this viewer needs
equally.** `docs/CONFORMANCE.md` carries what a gap costs; this carries how many there
are and where they live.

**"Read" means a shipped assembly contains the string.** That is a lower bound on
ignorance rather than proof of use — a name can be mentioned and still not honoured,
which is its own recurring bug here. A property this report calls read may still be
decoded and dropped.

**117 of 1122** declared table/property pairs are mentioned at all, across 173 tables.
